# MidBound Blog
> Person-level GTM insights from the founders of MidBound

MidBound provides person-level website visitor identification for B2B companies.
This blog contains insights on GTM strategy, ABM evolution, and B2B sales.

## Authors
- Sebastian Obadia, Co-Founder & CRO
- Eli Freedman, Co-Founder & CEO

## Topics
- Person-based marketing (PBM)
- Account-based marketing (ABM) evolution
- Website visitor identification
- B2B sales strategy
- Startup founder lessons
